description:
Are you sick and tired of being sick and tired? Then, let’s focus on solutions that help you restore energy at the cellular level. Soaking in magnesium is the only way to achieve true cell saturation. Magnesium is the master mineral that helps activate your vitamin D and supports hundreds of vital functions in your body. When your magnesium levels are balanced, your energy, mood, and overall wellness naturally improve. 

Join us as an affiliate and help others discover this simple, effective step toward better health, because health does not have to be complicated.

Welcome to Living the Good Life Naturally! Thanks for joining our Team Good Life Affiliate Program.

The following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.


1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration at our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.


2. Affiliate Coupon Code

Affiliates may advertise personal coupon codes and merchant website(s) on online personal channels, podcasts, and personal websites. Codes are not for personal use. Any affiliate who uses their code to receive discounts will be removed from the program. 

Exclusions include, but are not limited to sites such as coupon-generated sites, offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.


3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and does not include extra fees (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on the Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed using your personal discount code. Payment will not be made or applied post-transaction. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in chargebacks or refunds will not be paid out.


4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.


 5. Removal from Referral Program

Affiliate accounts will be reviewed quarterly. If no sales have been made your account will be deactivated. If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: Shelley at hello@livingthegoodlifenaturally.com.


Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send an email to Shelley at hello@livingthegoodlifenaturally.com for support.
